home.headline: Suhail Sakhizadh
home.subtitle: I research problems, talk to users and translate insights into digital products.

research.title: Research
research.text: I start by asking questions, listening and understanding the problem. My experience with Gen Z helps me focus my research while leaving room for what users themselves have to say.

design.title: Develop concepts
design.text: I connect research insights to possible solutions. I explore different directions and discuss ideas with others to develop a considered concept.

build.title: Prototype
build.text: I make ideas tangible through flows, screens and interactive prototypes. This lets others experience a solution and helps me test design decisions. My technical knowledge helps me develop those prototypes.

about.title: About me
about.description: I enjoy getting involved while the question is still open. What is happening, who is affected and which direction is worth exploring? That's the part that gets me thinking.
about.descriptionExtra: In a team, I contribute by researching, connecting insights and making ideas concrete. I develop concepts into prototypes, discuss the decisions and use feedback to refine them.
about.specialtyText: I've created many projects for Gen Z and developed my expertise with this audience through that work. I bring this experience to research, concept development and UX/UI, while continuing to investigate what the specific users of each project need.

ambitions.title: What drives me
ambitions.developerText: I enjoy thinking of different ways to approach a problem. Sketching and discussing ideas helps me discover which directions deserve further exploration.
ambitions.beyondText: I like contributing ideas and understanding how others see a problem. Different perspectives help me recognise my own assumptions and improve a concept.
ambitions.researchText: I want to understand what people do, where they struggle and why. That curiosity is the starting point for my research and design decisions.

skills.title: What I bring
skills.codingText: I make concepts tangible through flows, interfaces and interactive prototypes. My knowledge of React and other web technologies also lets me create working prototypes to explore ideas.
skills.entrepreneurshipText: I turn research insights into ideas, explore possible directions and explain my choices. I present concepts and work with others to develop them further.
skills.researchText: I investigate needs and involve users in the design process. My experience with many Gen Z projects helps me interpret insights and ask focused questions.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Want to know more about my projects, my approach or what I bring to a team? You can reach me on LinkedIn or by email.
